name: careguard-tn
description: CareGuard TN — Elderly Care, Medication Alerts & Home Nursing (Tunisia)

scripts.prepare:www: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('www',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); for(const f of fs.readdirSync('.')){ if(/\.(html|css|js|json|png|jpg|jpeg|svg|webp)$/i.test(f) && !['package.json','package-lock.json','capacitor.config.json'].includes(f)){ fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f); } }"
